title: Video Calls: Basics
drDigitalIntro:
Video calling lets you see and talk to someone face-to-face.
• This is a pretend video call. This website cannot turn on your real camera or microphone, and cannot see or hear you. On a real call, your computer will ask for permission first — and you will see a small light next to your camera when it is on.
• Apps like Zoom, Google Meet, and WhatsApp all do video calls the same way.
• Pick a contact and click the video call button to start.
• Your self-view shows what your camera sees. Click the red phone button to end the call.

playgroundTask.goal: You started and ended a video call

steps.say: Click on Grandma to open her conversation.
Start a video call with Grandma — click the green Video Call button.
You're connected. Now end the call by clicking the wide red End call button.

drDigitalSuccess: You made a video call. Green starts it, red ends it, and that is most of what there is to know.
drDigitalHint: Select Grandma first, then click the green Video Call button at the top of the chat.
